# Chapter 10: Cindy

After a while, Bob began using the singles site more actively — mostly to find someone to spend weekends with, to ease the loneliness that still followed him through the quiet hours. He went on several dates, each one pleasant enough but not especially meaningful.

Then he met Cindy.
